notes.title: Version 1.5.0
notes.content:
Version 1.5.0 brings some quality-of-life changes to the game's UI, a buff to credits gained when players first clear a stage, and some aspect ratio fixes for ultra-widescreen.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Stages now have a set number of credits the player gains when they complete it the first time.
[*] Menu UI now has some layering fixes so they shouldn't overlap strangely.
[*] Dai-Katana hitbox changes for ultra-widescreen.
[*] Stage left/right barriers more apparent (where player can move)
[/list]

tags.balance_change: Stages now have a set number of credits the player gains when they complete it the first time.

notes.title: 04/08/2020 - Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
This update addresses a number of bugs reported.

- Fix addressing the auto-unlocking Level 18 and Pet 4 achievements.
- Fix addressing game crashing when trying to view credits after beating last level
- Fix addressing Terror From Below achievement not unlocking
